title: Redesigning logistics tracking infrastructure
summary: A monolithic tracking system unable to scale during peak demand seasons.
challengeSummary: A monolithic tracking system unable to scale during peak demand seasons.
challengeDetails: During peak seasons shipment tracking degraded, and teams could not see which flow failed first.
approach: A modernization roadmap by service boundaries, with observability on the critical flows.

approachSteps.body: Identify the critical tracking flows and their load peaks.
Split the monolith by business boundary, starting with shipment tracking.
Visible technical risk and a review of each phase before the next peak season.

solution: Scalable service boundaries and observability on the critical flows, migrated in stages.

seo.title: Redesigning logistics tracking infrastructure | Representative case
seo.description: Representative scenario: how a logistics tracking monolith is split by service boundaries before the peak season.
